_comment: Issue #79 (journal & progression communication wave): THE canonical for the journal's three new results-only surfaces -- the Completed section (chosen-path HISTORY line), the Postings section's detail view (accepted posting/slip's own authored copy, recoverable even off the browsable board slate), and the per-class aspiration identity line. Loads journal_history_start (the_errand complete via kept_reward, bounty_road_cull + delivery_krshia_wool both accepted, mage held@1) and opens the journal once -- every new field asserted structurally off the SAME ui_journal_shown event the pre-existing skills/act/postings fields already ride (one event, no OCR). A trailing cursor move + toggle proves the pre-existing skill-row keyboard/click mechanism (issue #84's own QA-teeth target) still works correctly with the new sections rendered above it -- cursor_line is computed fresh off parts.size() every render, so the new content can never desync it. Canonical seed: 9 (fixture rng_state governs; held for convention).

steps._comment: Completed section: 'The Errand' resolved via kept_reward -- the chosen-path line, not a bare 'Complete.'. Postings section: BOTH the bounty and the delivery slip's own authored copy/slip_copy text, verbatim (WIBounties' real board strings, reused -- never re-authored, so this can't drift from what the board itself said). Skills section: 'Mage' heading (Lv 1) paired with its own authored aspiration line at the SAME index in class_aspirations; 'Innate' (index 0) carries none.

completed_quest_lines: The Errand — You kept the coin as your own courier's fee.
class_aspirations: Mages who refuse to narrow their craft are rare. The few who master its whole breadth are named [High Mages].
payload_contains.posting_detail: WATCH NOTICE. Goblin raiders, Floodplains road, east approach. Cull two bands. Proof by Guild attestation. 4 gold on turn-in. No spoils claims against the Watch. Second Shift.
payload_contains.delivery_detail: TO: Silverfang stall, market row. One wool bolt. Same waking. The Gnoll pays for dry, not for fast. It rains here, keep the paper on it.

steps._comment: Issue #209: the skill-row cursor lives on the SKILLS tab now, so switch to it (move_right, Quests->Skills) -- the emit carries active_tab:'skills' with the SAME full payload (skill fields unchanged, proving the split kept the payload tab-independent), and the cursor resets to row 0 (Innate's [Basic Cleaning]) on tab entry. (The a4 #216 touch drag-to-scroll proof this script used to carry moved to field_skills_loop's Skills tab: journal_history_start no longer overflows ANY single tab after the split -- measured -- so it can't prove scrolling; near_tactician's bigger kit can.)
steps.name: move_right

steps._comment: Issue #84 QA-teeth precedent: the pre-existing skill-row cursor still moves/toggles correctly on the Skills tab. GH#336 re-pin AND new teeth: the tab is category-primary and deduped now, so row 0 is [Frost Bolt] (Combat - Active, 3 AP) and one Down lands on [Quick Cast] (Combat - Passive) -- and a confirm on a PASSIVE row now REFUSES. That refusal is ruling 4's whole point: the checkbox used to be drawable and tickable on 41 of 119 catalog entries that ride hotbar_loadout and appear on no bar ever. `slottable:false` + `assigned:false` is the rendered fact; `loadout_changed` never fires for it (the assign leg right below is the contrast).
steps.name: move_down

steps._comment: ...and back up to row 0, [Frost Bolt], where the checkbox IS honest: the same confirm assigns it for real.
